intro.title: Pyrite Necklace Mala
intro.descriptionHtml: Collection of Pyrite Malas in exquisite designs and stringing patterns. Pyrite, also known as “Fool’s Gold,” is a powerful gemstone associated with abundance, confidence, and protection. This stone resonates with the Solar Plexus Chakra and is believed to attract wealth, success, and prosperity to the wearer. The Pyrite Mala acts as a shield against negative energies and environmental pollutants. It enhances willpower, motivation, and the ability to manifest goals. Wearing a Pyrite Mala helps boost self-confidence, focus, and mental clarity, empowering the wearer to take decisive action and overcome obstacles with courage.
